purpose: Bounded synthetic pair lifecycle/source identity diagnostics; not a production FileProvider repair.

changes.app: DEBUG pair create/existing, prePicker and actual returned/failure/cancel observations; at most first three explicit picker presentations; no timers/retries/selection injection.
changes.host: Post-test inventory reuses the existing CI invocation, reconstructs only recorded namespace/role basenames and reads each pair source once. All earlier lifecycle observations are preserved.
changes.identity: File data and parent identity come from the same open directory descriptor. O_NOFOLLOW, regular-file/link-count checks, named descriptor identity and parent path revalidation bound the observation.
changes.privacy: Only synthetic roles/namespace, stat fields, SHA256 of source bytes and standardized source path. No raw path, contents, selected-user URL or Live inventory.

validation.diagnostic_check: PASS: real PDFKit/POSIX; 24 pair records; replacement/missing/wrong-role; different/recreated directory; schema/marker/ordinal/duplicate rejection; existing single-file and silent Live/Release gates.

limitations: A post-test snapshot does not prove presence at the exact earlier picker failure.
The snapshot does not inspect internal FileProvider databases or assert why did=3 was absent.
Local macOS PDFKit and typechecks do not replace pending iOS runtime acceptance.
No retrial of selection and no fallback URL/picker was introduced.
